rationale: GEO deposits only two count columns: the single samuraciclib (ICEC0942, 0.35 uM, 8 days) library and the sum of all 16 control libraries (DMSO, ethanol, untreated and the spinner-flask time course), which is exactly the reference the paper's RANKS scoring used ('read counts from all time-points of the control screens were summed'). The per-sample control counts are not deposited, so the comparison is one library per arm and goes through the no-replicate path; calls are screening-level. Positive interactors (resistance, enriched) are the paper's main question (mTOR signalling).
